instrument: Colorado SB26-189, Automated Decision-Making Technology (Session Law Chapter 131)
sourceTitle: Colorado General Assembly, SB26-189 bill page and Signed Act (14 May 2026)
note: Bill page: became law, signed 14 May 2026, Session Law Chapter 131.
